title: DRDA: Implement some non string code points
description:
Use https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699939199/toc.pdf
to implement some code points that are enums based on integers or
hex, and a few that are collections, using a dissector table.
SECMEC, SVRCOD, SECCHKCD, MGRLVLLS,and the TYPDEFOVR collection with a
few common CCSID values.

Also add CCSIDXML and UNICODEMGR.

Related to #18945.
